jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.
You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.
A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.
You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

jobs.occupation: Forklift driver / Allround warehouse employee | Mechelen
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a varied and challenging job in the logistics sector? GXO Logistics in Mechelen is looking for motivated Allround Warehouse Operators to strengthen our team!

Your responsibilities

As an allround warehouse operator, you will be involved in various steps of the logistics process. Your tasks may include:

 

 
• Checking, packing, labeling, and preparing products for shipment 
 
• Repairing or adjusting damaged or incorrect goods (rework) 
 
• Performing customization tasks based on specific client requirements 
 
• Scanning and registering goods in the WMS system 
 
• Handling administrative tasks in Excel and Word 
 
• Moving goods using EPT, stacker, or forklift 
 
• Reporting discrepancies and results to the team leader 
 
• Assisting with inventory counts and stock control 
 
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment 

What are we looking for?

 

 
• You understand and speak fluent Dutch or English 
 
• You are available to work the night shift OR a 2-shift system 
 
• You have experience operating an EPT, stacker, and/or forklift 
 
• You are familiar with WMS systems, scanners, Excel, and Word 
 
• You work accurately, are well-organized, and have an eye for detail 
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently 
 
• You have at least 1 year of experience in a logistics or production environment 
 
• You are physically capable of lifting heavier objects

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Already living in Belgium and looking for a stable logistics job?

Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in warehouse work or logistics? And are you looking for a stable employer with a lot of job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

Step into the world of biotechnology and be part of a dynamic team! Legend Biotech, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for 
Cleaning Operators for their laboratory. You will be thoroughly
 trained in aseptic (germ-free) and GMP work and related procedures before joining our professional team. As a 
Cleaning Operator, you will be responsible for 
keeping the assigned areas and production zones within the laboratory spotlessly clean. You will ensure the maintenance of the equipment used and clean and disinfect materials with the highest accuracy. You handle cleaning products and materials in 
a safe and correct manner. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly temperature-controlled environment, where 
human lives depend on your diligence.

 
• Order and cleanliness are of great importance to you.
 
• Possible experience in an environment that needs to be kept clean is a plus
 
• An enthusiastic team player, you can work both accurately and independently.
 
• You have a good command of the Dutch or English language.
 
• Wearing a sterile suit and strict adherence to procedures are no problem for you.
